components.title: Agent Skill Library
components.purpose: Delivers reusable agent capabilities through self-contained skill directories, each carrying a SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter plus optional references, scripts, and templates.

primary.rationale: Every skill definition and its bundled references live here; this directory is the component.

shared.rationale: Skill scaffolding templates and the index generator are consumed by the command surface as well.

components.title: Slash Command Surface
components.purpose: Delivers namespaced slash commands through flat markdown files under commands/<namespace>/, where the team namespace additionally carries the four-layer orchestration router.

primary.rationale: All command definitions and the /team orchestration router live here.

components.title: Project Orchestration Systems
components.purpose: Delivers multi-phase project orchestration and persona-council capabilities through bundled system directories that ship their own nested skills and agents.

primary.rationale: The GSD, brain, superintelligence, and team bundles together with the core agent definitions they dispatch.

components.title: Editor Install Adapters
components.purpose: Delivers per-editor installation by symlinking skills, commands, and agents into each tool's configuration directory under a namespace mapping.

primary.rationale: The namespace mapping and symlink logic that make the repository installable across editors.

notes: Structural index only. Component altitude is C4-Container; these paths are not work-assignment boundaries.
